feedback: [INVENTED_CONSTRAINT] MainShape > sh:property[nltl:frameProfileType]: The requirement does not require every ship to provide a frame profile type; this mandatory ship-level condition is unrelated to the stated I2.6.1 obligations. Required change: Remove the frameProfileType property shape or make it non-mandatory and outside this requirement's conformance conditions. | [UNIT_CONVERSION] I2-031-StructuralMemberShape > SPARQL constraint: The combinedShearAndBendingDemand quantity is validated only for q:numericValue and has no unit or conversion constraint, yet its numeric value is directly compared with plasticStrength, which is required to be in kN. Required change: Require the demand quantity to carry a compatible force unit, preferably kN, or perform an explicit unit conversion before comparing it with plasticStrength. | [THRESHOLD_BOUNDARY] I2-031-StructuralMemberShape > SPARQL constraint > ABS(?strength - ?midspan) comparison: The candidate permits plasticStrength and midspanPlasticCollapseLoad to differ within an invented relative/absolute tolerance, although the requirement defines plastic strength by the magnitude of the midspan collapse load and supplies no tolerance. Required change: Use exact equality for the two decimal values, or encode only a specifically authoritative tolerance if one is supplied by the requirement context.

feedback: [APPLICABILITY] I2-031-ShipShape/sh:property[nltl:hasStructuralMember] and I2-031-StructuralMemberShape: The member shape is applied to every structural member linked from a ship and then requires every such member to be classified as bottom or side structure. I2.6.1 applies only to applicable local frames in bottom structures and transverse local frames in side structures, so this broad scope can impose the rule on non-applicable members. Required change: Restrict validation to the applicable local-frame population, including bottom local frames and transverse local frames in side structures, rather than all nltl:hasStructuralMember values. | [INVENTED_CONSTRAINT] I2-031-ShipShape/sh:property[nltl:frameProfileType]: The candidate makes frameProfileType mandatory on the ship, but the cited I2.6.1 requirement contains no obligation to provide a frame profile type. Required change: Remove the mandatory nltl:frameProfileType property constraint from this shape. | [INVENTED_CONSTRAINT] I2-031-ShipShape/sh:property[nltl:patchLoad]: The candidate makes a ship-level patchLoad quantity mandatory, although the requirement mandates the bottom-structure patch-load orientation, not a separate ship-level patch-load magnitude. Required change: Remove the mandatory ship-level nltl:patchLoad constraint, or represent patch-load information only where needed to enforce the required bottom-structure orientation. | [OWNERSHIP_PATH] I2-031-ShipShape/sh:property[nltl:plasticCollapseMechanism] and I2-031-StructuralMemberShape/sh:sparql: The plasticCollapseMechanism is required as an unrelated ship-level string and is not linked to the structural member's midspanPlasticCollapseLoad. Consequently, the candidate does not encode that plastic strength is the magnitude of the midspan load causing development of the plastic collapse mechanism; it only compares plasticStrength numerically with midspanPlasticCollapseLoad. Required change: Remove the unrelated ship-level string constraint and add a member-scoped semantic relationship or equivalent executable constraint linking the midspan collapse load to development of the plastic collapse mechanism, while retaining plasticStrength = midspanPlasticCollapseLoad.

current_issues.problem: The member shape is applied to every structural member linked from a ship and then requires every such member to be classified as bottom or side structure. I2.6.1 applies only to applicable local frames in bottom structures and transverse local frames in side structures, so this broad scope can impose the rule on non-applicable members.
current_issues.required_change: Restrict validation to the applicable local-frame population, including bottom local frames and transverse local frames in side structures, rather than all nltl:hasStructuralMember values.
current_issues.regression_guard: Preserve the applicable local-member scope and do not broaden the rule to unrelated ship structural members.
